declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this declaration in support of preliminary approval. After the complaint survived a motion to dismiss, counsel negotiated an arm’s-length settlement over two rounds. We initially proposed a $30 million class fund with automatic distribution and $4.5 million in separately paid fees and expenses. Brightline countered with a $25 million fund and $3 million in fees and expenses, retaining automatic distribution. We then proposed a $28 million fund and $4 million in fees and expenses, which Brightline accepted. Each proposal included fee approval by the Court, no clear-sailing provision, and payment of any unawarded fees to the class rather than Brightline. Fees were included in the parties’ proposals from the first round; they were not discussed only after class relief was agreed. The negotiations were confidential mediation communications. This account is provided for the Court’s evaluation of the settlement.
